sections.text_helper: Section 40.9.17 "CSI-2 Host flag clear register 1 (CSI_FCR1)" in chapter 40 (CSI-2 Host (CSI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2063.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x104
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:13 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 12 CECTRLDL1F: Clear D-PHY_RX lane 1 control error flag
Write 1 clears ECTRLDL1F flag in CSI_SR1.
Bit 11 CESYNCESCDL1F: Clear D-PHY_RX lane 1 low-power data transmission synchronization
error flag
Write 1 clears ESYNCESCDL1F flag in CSI_SR1.
Bit 10 CEESCDL1F: Clear D-PHY_RX lane 1 escape entry error flag
Write 1 clears the EESCDL1F flag in the CSI_SR1 register
Bit 9 CESOTSYNCDL1F: Clear SOT synchronization error flag on lane 1
Write 1 clears ESOTSYNCDL1F flag in CSI_SR1.
Bit 8 CESOTDL1F: Clear SOT error flag on lane 1
Write 1 clears ESOTDL1F flag in CSI_SR1.
Bits 7:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 CECTRLDL0F: Clear D-PHY_RX lane 0 control error flag
Write 1 clears ECTRLDL0F in CSI_SR1.
Bit 3 CESYNCESCDL0F: Clear D-PHY_RX lane 0 low-power data transmission synchronization
error flag
Write 1 clears ESYNCESCDL0F flag in CSI_SR1.
Bit 2 CEESCDL0F: Clear D-PHY_RX lane 0 escape entry error flag
Write 1 clears EESCDL0F flag in CSI_SR1.
Bit 1 CESOTSYNCDL0F: Clear SOT synchronization error flag on lane 0
Write 1 clears ESOTSYNCDL0F flag in CSI_SR1.
Bit 0 CESOTDL0F: Clear SOT error flag on lane 0
Write 1 clears ESOTDL0F flag in CSI_SR1.
